cards.title: Flying with kids: strangers' kindness makes all the difference
cards.body: A stressed parent traveling with four children experienced an unexpected act of kindness from a fellow passenger who helped comfort her sleeping son. These small gestures from strangers can transform stressful family travel experiences.

cards.title: Should you tell children about inheritance surprises?
cards.body: Parents wrestling with whether to reveal will contents to their children face a delicate decision. Financial advisors warn that unexpected inheritance plans can tear families apart if not handled thoughtfully.

cards.title: Family mealtimes create connection and reduce stress
cards.body: Eating together gives parents and children time to listen, share stories, and build meaningful relationships. Regular family meals provide essential pauses in busy days for genuine connection.

cards.title: Parenting an empty nester brings complicated emotions
cards.body: Taking a child to university triggers complex feelings of loss mixed with joy and relief. Parents navigate their own memories of independence while watching their children grow.

cards.title: Location-tracking apps reshape parent-child relationships
cards.body: Parents using tracking technology on loved ones report both reassurance and anxiety about constant surveillance. The question of whether monitoring promotes safety or breeds disconnection remains contested.

cards.title: FaceTime calls between homes can create anxiety
cards.body: Goodnight calls to the other parent don't always bring comfort and can trigger distress in children. How parents handle these conversations significantly impacts emotional well-being.

cards.title: Your tech habits teach children about screen time
cards.body: Parents monitoring kids' screen time often overlook their own device use as a powerful teaching tool. A parent's technology habits in front of children shape attitudes and behaviors more than rules alone.

cards.title: Tickling isn't always innocent play for children
cards.body: While tickling is commonly seen as playful, it can cause distress rather than joy depending on context and the child's feelings. Understanding when tickling crosses from fun to uncomfortable is important for parents.

cards.title: ADHD medications: Understanding four newer treatment options
cards.body: Four new ADHD medications have emerged over five years, offering parents and doctors expanded treatment choices. A psychiatrist explains each option and why switching treatments may not always be beneficial.

cards.title: Antipsychotics for ADHD: The importance of medication sequencing
cards.body: Half of children started on antipsychotics never tried stimulants first, representing a concerning prescribing gap. Better medication sequencing with systematic deprescribing could improve child outcomes.

cards.title: Family estrangement causes and potential paths to reconciliation
cards.body: Family cutoffs occur more frequently than many realize, with complex causes ranging from trauma to values conflicts. Understanding estrangement dynamics helps parents and adult children navigate painful separations.

cards.title: Attachment styles shape your child's health outcomes
cards.body: A child's attachment security influences pain perception, anger management, and substance abuse risk throughout life. Early parenting patterns create lasting impacts on emotional and physical health.
